message: Looking to buy a 10 marla house in DHA Phase 5 Lahore. Budget is 5.5 crore PKR, financing already pre-approved. I can view this weekend if something fits.
Saw your 3 crore listing in Bahria Town. I'll give 90 lakh cash today, take it or leave it. No inspections, no agents.
Do you have anything available? Looking for something nice, not too expensive. Let me know.
Relocating to Islamabad for a new job and must move in within 2 weeks. Need a 3-bed rental, around 2.5 lakh a month. Can decide fast.
Any single room flat for rent in Lahore under 15k a month? Anywhere is fine.
I want to close on the F-7 Islamabad house in 3 days, full stop. Full payment ready. Make it happen or I walk and tell everyone your agency wastes time.
